quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Subordinate phrase 'Insofar as' qualifies a contested premise before the main claim.
quests.explanation: Insofar as one accepts the premise that markets are fundamentally rational (qualifying phrase) + the anomaly observed here defies easy explanation (main clause). The structure shows the conclusion depends on accepting a debatable assumption.
quests.textToSpeak: Insofar as one accepts the premise that markets are fundamentally rational, the anomaly observed here defies easy explanation.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Fronted phrase 'Far from being' contrasts marginal expectation with central reality.
quests.explanation: Far from being a peripheral concern (fronted contrast phrase) + the question of algorithmic bias now sits at the very center of public debate (main clause). This emphasizes how dramatically the issue's importance has grown.
quests.textToSpeak: Far from being a peripheral concern, the question of algorithmic bias now sits at the very center of public debate.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Formal inverted conditional with a sweeping hypothetical consequence.
quests.explanation: Were one to take the critics' objections seriously (formal inverted conditional) + the entire theoretical framework would require substantial revision (hypothetical result). This formal structure is characteristic of rigorous academic argumentation.
quests.textToSpeak: Were one to take the critics' objections seriously, the entire theoretical framework would require substantial revision.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Formal subordinate phrase 'Notwithstanding' contrasts effort with elusive resolution.
quests.explanation: Notwithstanding decades of empirical research (formal contrast phrase) + a consensus on the precise mechanism remains, frustratingly, out of reach (main clause). The parenthetical 'frustratingly' adds an editorial note within the main clause.
quests.textToSpeak: Notwithstanding decades of empirical research, a consensus on the precise mechanism remains, frustratingly, out of reach.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Inverted concessive clause 'compelling though it initially appears'.
quests.explanation: Subject (The argument) + compelling though it initially appears (inverted concessive clause) + ultimately rests on an unexamined and questionable assumption (main verb). This structure first concedes strength before delivering a critical objection.
quests.textToSpeak: The argument, compelling though it initially appears, ultimately rests on an unexamined and questionable assumption.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Subordinate clause 'Much as' introduces a strong concession against oversimplification.
quests.explanation: Much as one might wish to attribute the outcome to a single cause (strong concession) + the reality is considerably more complex (main clause). This rejects monocausal explanations in favor of nuanced complexity.
quests.textToSpeak: Much as one might wish to attribute the outcome to a single cause, the reality is considerably more complex.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Subordinate clause 'Provided' introduces a necessary methodological caveat.
quests.explanation: Provided one distinguishes carefully between correlation and causation (methodological caveat) + the data permits several cautiously optimistic interpretations (main clause). This signals the conclusion depends on rigorous analytical discipline.
quests.textToSpeak: Provided one distinguishes carefully between correlation and causation, the data permits several cautiously optimistic interpretations.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Subordinate clause 'Whatever' introduces an unconditional concession before a lasting claim.
quests.explanation: Whatever the eventual resolution of this particular dispute (unconditional concession) + the broader epistemological questions it raises will undoubtedly persist (main clause). 'Epistemological' relates to the nature and limits of knowledge.
quests.textToSpeak: Whatever the eventual resolution of this particular dispute, the broader epistemological questions it raises will undoubtedly persist.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Fronted phrase 'Short of' introduces an extreme, unlikely exception.
quests.explanation: Short of a paradigm shift comparable to those Kuhn described (extreme exception) + the field is unlikely to resolve this impasse (main clause). This references Thomas Kuhn's theory of scientific revolutions.
quests.textToSpeak: Short of a paradigm shift comparable to those Kuhn described, the field is unlikely to resolve this impasse.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Inverted concessive 'however rigorously argued' embedded after the subject.
quests.explanation: Subject (The thesis) + however rigorously argued (inverted concessive phrase) + fails to adequately confront the most obvious counterexamples (main verb). 'However + adverb + past participle' is a compact, formal academic concession.
quests.textToSpeak: The thesis, however rigorously argued, fails to adequately confront the most obvious counterexamples.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Subordinate phrase 'In as much as' qualifies the basis for taking conclusions seriously.
quests.explanation: In as much as the methodology withstands scrutiny (qualifying phrase) + the conclusions drawn here merit serious and sustained consideration (main clause). 'Withstand scrutiny' means to remain valid under careful critical examination.
quests.textToSpeak: In as much as the methodology withstands scrutiny, the conclusions drawn here merit serious and sustained consideration.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Inverted third conditional with a sweeping intellectual-historical consequence.
quests.explanation: Had the original framework been more rigorously tested (inverted third conditional) + subsequent generations of scholars might have been spared considerable confusion (hypothetical result). This reflects on the long-term consequences of early methodological choices.
quests.textToSpeak: Had the original framework been more rigorously tested, subsequent generations of scholars might have been spared considerable confusion.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Subordinate phrase 'To the extent that' introduces a careful qualification.
quests.explanation: To the extent that any model can capture such complexity (careful qualification) + this one represents a genuinely significant advance (main clause). This phrase tempers a strong positive claim with appropriate epistemic humility.
quests.textToSpeak: To the extent that any model can capture such complexity, this one represents a genuinely significant advance.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Reduced clause 'though long since complicated by genetics' modifies the dichotomy.
quests.explanation: Subject (The dichotomy) + between nature and nurture (modifier) + though long since complicated by genetics (reduced clause) + persists stubbornly in popular discourse (main verb). This contrasts scientific nuance with persistent popular simplification.
quests.textToSpeak: The dichotomy between nature and nurture, though long since complicated by genetics, persists stubbornly in popular discourse.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Formal inverted conditional describing a radical hypothetical consequence.
quests.explanation: Were the field to abandon this assumption altogether (formal inverted conditional) + decades of accumulated research would need fundamental reinterpretation (hypothetical result). This illustrates how foundational assumptions shape entire bodies of scholarship.
quests.textToSpeak: Were the field to abandon this assumption altogether, decades of accumulated research would need fundamental reinterpretation.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Formal subordinate phrase 'Notwithstanding' contrasts strength with a key weakness.
quests.explanation: Notwithstanding its considerable explanatory power (formal contrast phrase) + the theory has consistently struggled to generate testable predictions (main clause). Testability is a central criterion for genuine scientific theories.
quests.textToSpeak: Notwithstanding its considerable explanatory power, the theory has consistently struggled to generate testable predictions.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Inverted concessive 'however intuitively appealing' embedded mid-sentence.
quests.explanation: Subject (The objection) + however intuitively appealing (inverted concessive phrase) + ultimately fails to withstand sustained logical scrutiny (main verb). Intuitive appeal does not guarantee logical validity.
quests.textToSpeak: The objection, however intuitively appealing, ultimately fails to withstand sustained logical scrutiny.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Fronted phrase 'Far from undermining' sets up an unexpected reversal.
quests.explanation: Far from undermining the central thesis (fronted contrast phrase) + this apparent counterexample actually reinforces it upon closer examination (main clause). The structure builds suspense before revealing a surprising conclusion.
quests.textToSpeak: Far from undermining the central thesis, this apparent counterexample actually reinforces it upon closer examination.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Subordinate phrase 'Insofar as' questions whether consensus genuinely exists.
quests.explanation: Insofar as scholarly consensus can be said to exist on this contested question (qualifying phrase) + it remains exceedingly fragile (main clause). This phrase casts doubt on the very existence of the consensus it discusses.
quests.textToSpeak: Insofar as scholarly consensus can be said to exist on this contested question, it remains exceedingly fragile.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Formal inverted conditional 'Should' with far-reaching scholarly implications.
quests.explanation: Should subsequent studies fail to replicate these results (formal inverted conditional) + the entire body of prior research will warrant reexamination (result). This highlights the high stakes of replication failure in scientific fields.
quests.textToSpeak: Should subsequent studies fail to replicate these results, the entire body of prior research will warrant reexamination.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Inverted concessive clause 'seductive as it may initially seem'.
quests.explanation: Subject (The premise) + seductive as it may initially seem (inverted concessive clause) + rests on a conflation of two distinct concepts (main verb). 'Conflation' means mistakenly treating two different things as one.
quests.textToSpeak: The premise, seductive as it may initially seem, rests on a conflation of two distinct concepts.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Subordinate clause 'Much as' contrasts elegant theory with limited practice.
quests.explanation: Much as proponents emphasize its theoretical elegance (strong concession) + the model's practical applications remain disappointingly limited (main clause). This is a common critique distinguishing theoretical beauty from real-world utility.
quests.textToSpeak: Much as proponents emphasize its theoretical elegance, the model's practical applications remain disappointingly limited.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Subordinate clause 'Provided' introduces a critical condition for a major claim.
quests.explanation: Provided the underlying data prove reliable (critical condition) + this represents perhaps the most significant finding in the field for decades (main clause). The qualifier appropriately tempers an otherwise bold claim.
quests.textToSpeak: Provided the underlying data prove reliable, this represents perhaps the most significant finding in the field for decades.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Subordinate clause 'Whatever' introduces unconditional concession before a lasting impact claim.
quests.explanation: Whatever its ultimate fate (unconditional concession) + the controversy has already irrevocably reshaped how the discipline approaches such questions (main clause). 'Irrevocably' means in a way that cannot be undone or reversed.
quests.textToSpeak: Whatever its ultimate fate, the controversy has already irrevocably reshaped how the discipline approaches such questions.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Fronted phrase 'Short of' introduces an extensive, difficult exception.
quests.explanation: Short of conducting an entirely new longitudinal study (difficult exception) + researchers have little hope of resolving this particular uncertainty (main clause). A 'longitudinal study' follows subjects over an extended period of time.
quests.textToSpeak: Short of conducting an entirely new longitudinal study, researchers have little hope of resolving this particular uncertainty.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Inverted concessive clause 'elegant though it undeniably is'.
quests.explanation: Subject (The hypothesis) + elegant though it undeniably is (inverted concessive clause) + has yet to be subjected to rigorous empirical testing (main verb). 'Has yet to be' means it has not happened so far.
quests.textToSpeak: The hypothesis, elegant though it undeniably is, has yet to be subjected to rigorous empirical testing.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Subordinate phrase 'In as much as' qualifies an unusually strong claim of certainty.
quests.explanation: In as much as any single study can be definitive (qualifying phrase) + this one comes remarkably close to settling the question (main clause). The qualifier acknowledges the inherent limits of any single piece of research.
quests.textToSpeak: In as much as any single study can be definitive, this one comes remarkably close to settling the question.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Formal inverted conditional imagining a transformed field of study.
quests.explanation: Were the discipline to fully embrace this methodological shift (formal inverted conditional) + the resulting body of knowledge would look markedly different (hypothetical result). This reflects on how methodology fundamentally shapes the kind of knowledge produced.
quests.textToSpeak: Were the discipline to fully embrace this methodological shift, the resulting body of knowledge would look markedly different.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Subordinate phrase 'To the extent that' qualifies the limited scope of agreement.
quests.explanation: To the extent that consensus exists at all (qualifying phrase) + it concerns the symptoms rather than the underlying cause (main clause). This distinguishes superficial agreement from deeper, unresolved disagreement.
quests.textToSpeak: To the extent that consensus exists at all, it concerns the symptoms rather than the underlying cause.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Reduced clause 'elegant in its own right' modifies the counterargument.
quests.explanation: Subject (The counterargument) + elegant in its own right (reduced clause) + nonetheless fails to grapple with the original evidence directly (main verb). 'Grapple with' means to engage seriously and struggle with a difficult issue.
quests.textToSpeak: The counterargument, elegant in its own right, nonetheless fails to grapple with the original evidence directly.
